author: lodekeeper
content:
Adding the backlog entry first, then pulling the images.

Pulling the exact CL image commits on devnet-12 from Dora, then I'll check each client's source for the pre-fork deposit sig cache.

Lighthouse, Lodestar and Grandine are done. Checking Teku's signature helper now, then Prysm and Nimbus.

Results are in for all six. One last check on whether Teku has caching work open upstream.

@nflaig Five of the six CL images on devnet-12 have the pre-fork deposit sig cache. Teku doesn't. I checked the exact commits the nodes report in Dora. The spec note asking for this is from [consensus-specs#5227](<https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5227>).
- **Lighthouse `8e0aeef`: yes.** `OnboardBuildersCache` is an LRU with 262k entries. It's seeded from the head state at startup, updated on every block import, and `upgrade_to_gloas` reads it, verifying inline on a miss.
- **Lodestar `32db66b`: yes.** `BuilderDepositSignatureCache` gets filled in `prepareNextSlot` during the 2 epochs before the fork. Each run handles up to 10k deposits within about 20% of a slot. It skips epoch-transition slots and slots right before we propose.
- **Prysm `1b67dd8`: yes.** `IsValidDepositSignature` goes through `cache.DepositSignature` (cap 2^19). `runGloasDepositWarmup` fills it starting 2 epochs before the fork, with a 2s per slot budget.
- **Grandine `d940f70a`: yes.** A `CacheDepositSignaturesTask` runs on each block, and the cache is seeded at startup. It holds 65,536 entries and keeps the tail. Anything left over is verified in parallel at the fork.
- **Nimbus `e53a78`: partial.** It caches signatures of builder-credential deposit requests as it processes each block, in memory only. Nothing seeds the cache from the state's `pending_deposits`. So a node that restarts or checkpoint-syncs after the deposits land will verify all of them inline at the fork.
- **Teku `115ab40018`: no.** `GloasStateUpgrade.onboardBuildersFromPendingDeposits` calls `isValidDepositSignature` inline with

author: lodekeeper
content:
the plain verifier, so every state upgrade across the fork re-verifies the whole set. It also verifies every validator deposit for a new pubkey in the queue, not just the ones a builder deposit needs. Teku master is 1 commit ahead of the image and that commit is unrelated. I found no caching PR in their recent PRs.

So Teku is the one to watch at epoch 225. Nimbus should be fine as long as its nodes don't restart between the deposits landing and the fork.

author: lodekeeper
content:
@jtraglia Yes. Every image commit is already merged into that client's main dev branch, so none of them are feature branches:
- Lighthouse, Prysm, Grandine and Nimbus are running exactly the tip of `unstable`/`develop`.
- Lodestar is 2 commits behind `unstable` and Teku is 1 behind `master`. Those newer commits don't touch deposits, so the answer is the same for Teku: still no cache.

One caveat: Lighthouse's and Nimbus's `stable` branches don't have it yet. The devnet commits are 260 and 57 commits ahead of `stable`, so it hasn't shipped in a release for those two. I didn't check release status for the other four.
